mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies observed near the Verona Public Library, while the waxing gibbous moon is currently visible.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday, which will also result in a delay for refuse and recycling collection services until Friday, November 27.
There is plenty to do in town with live music performances taking place today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's.

In a noteworthy incident on November 2, officers responded to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 48-year-old man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough, and you can head over to grab a scoop when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
